messages:
Maya: heads up — since ~10:12 UTC our prometheus remote_write p95 errors spiked and grafana SLO noise went through the roof for gpu-exporter scrapes in us-west2\. noticed cardinality explosion too
Sam: any logs/stack traces? rate?
Maya: remote_write logs show a lot of 504s and timeouts, also prometheus scrape samples jumped from ~40k -> 1\.2M for that target group
Maya: logs snippet:
```
level=warn ts=2025-11-03T10:12:15Z caller=remote.go msg="remote write failed" status=504 err="write timeout"
level=info ts=2025-11-03T10:12:16Z caller=scrape.go target="gpu-exporter/us-west2/daemonset" samples=1245123
```
Sam: wow 1.2M samples — sounds like label churn. any recent daemonset or exporter changes?
Jules: We rolled gpu-exporter 2 days ago to add per-pod gpu_uuid label to help tracking. That will explode cardinality if the label is dynamic/per-container
Devon: if gpu_uuid is unique per GPU instance that's expected — you either need to relabel/drop it or move that metric to a lower scrape frequency
Maya: current relabel config is pretty light, we don't drop gpu_uuid:
```
- action: keep
  source_labels: [__name__]
  regex: "gpu_.*"
```
Sam: propose immediate quick-fix: add a relabel_config to drop the gpu_uuid label on scrape side before it hits remote_write
Jules: agree. e.g.
```
- action: labeldrop
  regex: "gpu_uuid|pod_unique_id|container_instance"
```
Devon: also suggest throttling scrape for that daemonset from 15s -> 5m during investigation to avoid filling remote_write buffers
Maya: can we also mute the alerting noise? our SLO alert fired across 20 services
Devon: I pushed a temporary suppression on the prometheus-slo-alerting rule for the gpu-exporter group for 2 hours
ops-bot: ops-bot: triggered deploy/gpu-exporter-rollback (by DevOps) at 2025-11-03T10:20:04Z
Maya: applied relabel delete + throttle, remote_write errors dropping already p95 -> 0\.8%
Sam: nice — any follow-up? permanent fix options: 1) patch exporter to not expose volatile IDs as labels 2) use relabel to hash id to reduce cardinality 3) move some metrics to pushgateway or aggregated counter
Jules: ticket created: INFRA-1934 to evaluate exporter change + decide label policy. I'll own.
Maya: thanks all, monitoring for 30m, will remove suppression after we confirm stability
Devon: closing loop — after 30m p95 stayed <1% and samples back to ~42k — reopening alerts disabled
Maya: closing thread, will update INFRA-1934 with timeline and config diff
